title: Twenty years after Steve Jobs released the iMac, Apple's famous line of computers account for only a tenth its business (AAPL)
text: Twenty years after Steve Jobs released the iMac, Apple's famous line of computers account for only a tenth its business (AAPL) By Prachi Bhardwaj May 7, 2018, 6:32 pm 13 pts When Steve Jobs released the iMac in 1998, the bright-colored computer was a lifesaver for Apple, whose business was almost entirely based on Mac sales. Twenty years later, Apple is a completely different company. As this chart from Statista shows, the percentage of Apple's revenue attributable…
